What LTC Properties says to expect

  • Full year 2026: SHOP investment and net operating incomeLTC is increasing its 2026 SHOP investment mid-point guidance to $1 billion from $900 million. Additionally, LTC is narrowing its 2026 SHOP NOI guidance to a range of $73.5 million to $76.4 million, from $71.2 million to $79.9 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
